requirements.requirement: Provide tidy storage for sewing supplies
requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster (piece:0,0,0; piece:1,0,0; piece:0,1,0) with divided bins: 2x hex-bin-full-div2 and 1x hex-bin-full-div3 gives 7 compartments for sorting threads, buttons, needles, scissors, tape measure etc. Caps and joint bolts fitted.

Under 40 parts (18 parts, 1623g), three hex cells side-by-side ~ 300mm wide, sits on bench

finish.summary: Built a compact 3-cell Hex Cluster organizer with 7 divided compartments across two 2-compartment bins and one 3-compartment bin. Capped open faces and locked joints, staged with workshop props (pencil cup, tweezers, tape reels, small-parts heaps) as stand-ins for sewing notions to show tidy sewing storage.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
